verdict.rationale: Anthropic explicitly states Claude Code skills follow the open Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io) that works across multiple AI tools, and the same SKILL.md folder format (frontmatter + markdown, optional scripts/references/assets dirs) is documented both on the vendor docs and the independent agentskills.io spec site. Missing for 10: no third-party/independent tool (outside Anthropic) is shown actually consuming the same folder, and community commentary questions skill invocation reliability rather than spec portability.
